blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES:  Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 12, 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court resumes proceedings on Thursday, with the defense set to present Bank of the Philippine Islands Senior Vice President Atty. Paul Roderick Ysmael as its fifth witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

items: Ysmael is expected to testify on the letter requests made by Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, through their legal counsel, as the defense continues to counter allegations of unexplained wealth.
Other witnesses scheduled to provide corroborating testimonies are Chadrin Parian and Quezon City Prosecutor Vimar Barcellano.

On Day 42, defense witness Suzette Balucanag-Punay testified that Duterte received P2.14 million from GenCorp between 2022 and 2025 as a return of capital from an investment in a Jollibee branch in Davao City.
Punay admitted she could not produce written records establishing the amount or terms of Duterte’s original investment. She also acknowledged that “loose investment” had no technical definition.
The defense withdrew its planned presentation of 15 bank executives, leaving BPI’s Ysmael as the only bank representative scheduled to testify this week.
